item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E021","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E022","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E023","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Committee welcomed Egypt’s anti-trafficking measures, including the 2022–2026 national strategy and coordinating committee, but found persistent trafficking, inadequate enforcement, failure to fully operationalize the national referral mechanism and national assistance trust fund, and low prosecution and conviction rates.","notes":["The excerpt supports a singular national assistance trust fund, not plural victim-assistance funds.","The summary was narrowed to the excerpt’s wording about failure to fully operationalize the referral mechanism and assistance trust fund."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E024","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E025","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The treaty record lists the United Arab Republic as a participant in a signature action and records a registration date of 25 May 1970.","notes":["The excerpt labels 25 May 1970 as the registration date, not explicitly as the signature date."]}]}
